overall_notes: The paper focuses on zero-shot cross-lingual event argument extraction using generative language models. It formulates EAE as a text generation task where models generate structured outputs using language-agnostic templates. The evaluation is primarily through automatic F1 scores comparing predicted vs. ground truth argument-role pairs. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted.
